Leadership

A warm welcome from our Leadership.

Meet the people who set the tone, every single day.

Our Mission

To nurture curious, confident learners through joyful, child-led education that honors each child's unique pace and gifts.

Our Vision

To be Visakhapatnam's most loved learning home — where children grow into kind thinkers, brave creators, and lifelong friends.

Our Values

Kindness, curiosity, courage, community. We celebrate effort, embrace play, and treat every classroom as a tiny garden of wonder.

Y. Ravi Krishna

Director & Correspondent

Every child carries limitless potential. At Little Champs, we strive to create a joyful environment where curiosity grows into confidence, character, and lifelong learning."

Y. Vijaya Lakshmi

Principal

We believe learning should inspire children to explore, create, and dream big. Our goal is to nurture every child with care, values, and academic excellence."
